statement.zh: Diehl 2004 是面向公众的奥尔梅克二手综合（书名含排名用语，本仓不采为定论）。
statement.en: Diehl 2004 is a public-facing secondary synthesis on the Olmec; the book title uses ranking language (“America’s First Civilization”) that this archive does not adopt as fact.
